carousels.caption: Why are my facebook ads not working. That's the question I get most, and almost every time the targeting is fine. CTR's fine. CPM's fine. Leads are even booking. It still dies around $200 to $300 spent. That's not an audience problem. That's an offer problem. Swipe through for the four checks to run before you touch anything.
carousels.pinnedComment: Why facebook ads stop working even when CTR and CPM look good, and the four checks to run before you touch your targeting.

carousels.caption: If your ad set has 10 headlines but they're all the same picture and the same offer, you don't have 10 ads. You have one, repeated. Most owners asking why their facebook ads are not working are running one idea with ten different outfits on it. Swipe through for the actual count and what makes an ad count as a different one.
carousels.pinnedComment: If you're not sure how many ads should be running, or you're trying to figure out why your facebook ads are not working, this one's for you.

carousels.caption: If you added a separate retargeting ad set before your daily budget caught up, that's probably why it's not converting. Swipe through for the exact number where a retargeting ad set stops starving your account and what to do before you hit it.
carousels.cta: Comment AUDIT and I'll send you the 11-point checklist so you catch this before you spend another dollar.
carousels.pinnedComment: A separate retargeting ad set under $60 a day splits your volume instead of growing it. Keep one ad set and exclude your customer list and your last 180 days of leads until you cross that number.

carousels.caption: When should you actually kill an ad? Most owners either pull the plug after one bad day or let a dead ad bleed money for weeks because nobody set a number up front. Here's the exact ratio that tells you when it's over, and when it just needs a couple more days.
carousels.cta: Comment MATH and I'll send you the blank sheet so you can set your own target CPA and run the math.
carousels.pinnedComment: If your cost per lead is running 3x your target after you've spent 2-3x that target chasing it, and the ad is past day 7 and $100, kill it. If it's 1.5-3x, give it a few more days before you touch anything.
